title: Sensor Faults and the Suspension of FloodPay Cover
content:
**Sensor faults.** Under FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines), when the sensor sends no report for more than the tier's fault threshold in elapsed hours, cover is suspended from the moment of its last report and Tidemark repairs or replaces it within the tier's repair target in business days at no charge; cover resumes when the sensor reports again. No payout is made for an event that starts during a suspension, and the term is not extended or the premium returned for it.

## The condition in parts

| Part | Content |
|---|---|
| What starts the clock | The sensor's last report |
| What is measured | Elapsed hours with no report from the sensor |
| When cover is suspended | When the silence runs for more than the fault threshold |
| From when the suspension runs | From the moment of the sensor's last report, not from the moment the threshold is passed |
| Policy status while suspended | Sensor fault |
| Repair | Tidemark repairs or replaces the sensor within the repair target in business days, at no charge to the policyholder |
| End of the suspension | When the sensor, repaired or replaced, reports again; the policy returns to active |
| Flood events in the suspension | No payout for an event that starts during a suspension |
| Term and premium | The term is not extended and no premium is returned for the suspension |

## Illustration on a hypothetical timeline

*Hypothetical inputs:* a fault threshold of T elapsed hours; the sensor's last report is at a given moment M; nothing more is heard from it until a replacement sensor reports some days later.

- Once the silence after M has run for more than T hours, cover is suspended, and the suspension is dated from M itself.
- A flood event whose start falls after M and before the replacement sensor reports starts during the suspension: no payout is made for it.
- When the replacement sensor reports, cover resumes and the policy is active again.
- The term end date stays as it was, and no premium is returned for the days of the suspension.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the policyholder charged for the repair or replacement of a faulty sensor?**
No. Tidemark repairs or replaces it at no charge.

**Does a suspension lengthen the term to make up for the lost days?**
No. The term is not extended for a suspension, and no premium is returned for it.

**Is the suspension counted from the moment the threshold is crossed?**
No. Cover is suspended from the moment of the sensor's last report.
